history.name: Wiring into a coding agent
history.description: Setup appends a short stanza to whichever agent instruction files the repo already has — CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md, .cursor/rules, .github/copilot-instructions.md or .windsurfrules — and creates AGENTS.md when there are none. The stanza is a pointer rather than a copy: it names six commands, the tone the project writes in, and the rule that a feature change is not finished until the ledger records it. The --agents flag chooses the files, and changing the tone rewrites the stanza in every one of them.
history.dev_notes: AGENT_FILES, wireAgents() and refreshAgents() in src/commands/init.mjs; the text is assets/agent-pointer.md, fenced by <!-- feature-ledger --> markers so a second run skips a file it has already written.
